CustomField.description: When Documents are deleted from a Case LastModifiedDate is updated to cause EDW to pick up the new information. This flag disables that to allow for bulk deletion without EDW alerting.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When Documents are deleted from a Case LastModifiedDate is updated to cause EDW to pick up the new information. This flag disables that to allow for bulk deletion without EDW alerting.
CustomField.label: Disable Document Deletion Trigger
